accepted_answer: Mark explicitly locates the scene in Capernaum after some days, with a crowd filling the house and doorway.
Four people carry the paralytic and open the roof because they cannot get through the crowd.
The scribes reason in their hearts that only God can forgive sins; Jesus perceives their reasoning.
The healed man immediately takes up his mat and goes out before everyone; the people say they never saw anything like it.
